# navig-media

> The NAVIG media suite in one install: image and video generation, voice and music, writing, and the assembly line that downloads, transcribes, scripts, narrates and publishes.

**Works on its own** — its own CLI, no navig required · v0.2.0 · not on PyPI yet (install from source below)

**On its own** (no navig needed)

```bash
pip install "git+https://github.com/navig-run/plugins#subdirectory=navig-media"
navig-media --help   # no navig needed
```

**With navig**

```bash
pip install "git+https://github.com/navig-run/plugins#subdirectory=navig-media"
```

<!-- navig:plugin-card:end -->

**The NAVIG media suite in one install.** One command pulls every component of the studio:

| Component | What it does | Standalone / in navig |
|---|---|---|
| `navig-generate` | image and video generation | `navig-generate` / `navig generate` |
| `navig-audio` | voice (TTS/STT), music, sound effects | `navig-audio` / `navig audio` |
| `navig-text` | drafts, captions, lyrics | `navig-text` / `navig text` |
| `navig-video` | edit, render and encode footage | `navig-video` / `navig video` |
| `navig-pipeline` | content production: script → narrate → cut → publish | `navig-content` (or `navig-pipeline`) / `navig content` |
| `navig-download` | acquire media from the web | `navig-download` / `navig download` |
| `navig-social` | publish to networks | `navig-social` / `navig social` |

```bash
pip install navig-media          # the whole suite
navig-media                      # what is installed, with versions and commands
pip install "navig-media[film]"  # + filming live URLs through a browser
```

Every piece is **standalone-first**: each keeps its own CLI, its own keys, and works with
navig absent. This package is only the bundle — a dependency list plus `navig-media`, which
reports what your studio contains.

Inside navig, the same components light up as `navig generate`, `navig audio`,
`navig text`, `navig video`, `navig content`, `navig download`, `navig social`, and NAVIG OS shows the
Media Studio surface.

## Why a bundle

Installed individually the suite is seven decisions; `navig-media` makes it one. It follows the
same rule the parts do: **it never pins navig** — bring the operator or run each tool alone.
